// PROBE — the pre-fix AddCustomerModal «Έξυπνη Μεταφόρτωση PDF» door, as it
// shipped before 2026-09-04. It hands the File to parsePolicyPdfWithGemini,
// copies the extracted fields into the manual form, and then submits
// addCustomerManually WITHOUT the file: the policy was created active with
// zero documents and no analysis. The matcher in
// tests/unit/upload-accept-matches-server.test.ts must flag this shape.
"use client"

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react'
import { addCustomerManually, parsePolicyPdfWithGemini } from '@/app/(protected)/agent/actions'

export function AddCustomerModalProbe() {
    const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ name: '', addPolicy: false, policy: { insurerName: '' } })
    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

    const handleManualSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        await addCustomerManually({
            name: formData.name,
            policy: formData.addPolicy ? formData.policy : undefined,
        })
    }

    const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        const file = e.target.files?.[0]
        if (!file) return
        const formDataObj = new FormData()
        formDataObj.append('file', file)
        const result = await parsePolicyPdfWithGemini(formDataObj)
        if ('success' in result && result.data) {
            setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, addPolicy: true, policy: { insurerName: result.data.insurerName || '' } }))
        }
    }

    return (
        <form onSubmit={handleManualSubmit}>
            <input type="file" ref={fileInputRef} onChange={handleFileUpload} className="hidden" />
        </form>
    )
}
